name: eidos
description: Use the live Eidos CLI as the progressive-reveal gateway into Eidos AGI systems.

interface.shortDescription: Use Eidos as the gateway into Eidos AGI systems.
interface.longDescription: Eidos is the gateway Codex plugin for Eidos AGI. It keeps Codex out of giant MCP surfaces by pointing first to the installed Eidos CLI, where broad platform questions can progressively reveal the right specialist CLI such as Rhea, Foreman, Reeves, Surfari, Forge-Forge, or Eidos Vault.
defaultPrompt: Ask Eidos which system should handle this.
Use Eidos to check platform health.
Use Eidos Vault to find the right secret path.
